description: This file implements the admin controller for managing return reasons in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It provides methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting return reasons, with proper routing, permission checks, and view rendering.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Controller class managing return reasons in the admin interface for Opencart. Extends the core Controller class, providing CRUD and listing functionalities for return reasons.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point, loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumbs, and renders the return reason list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches and outputs the list of return reasons, primarily for AJAX calls.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of return reasons with pagination, sorting, and links for editing.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a return reason, loading associated data and views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of a return reason, performing validation, permission checks, and database updates.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return reasons after permission and dependency checks.
